## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor the environment default so CI jobs can exclude files through their existing configuration.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by name and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds tests for argument parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, `default=[]` leaves `debug.log` in the archive. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` says “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files their operators intended to omit. — Fix: Document the environment default and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover both a set and an unset `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.
